module: CUR-O1 observation order; CUR-S1 class-protected support weighting
authors: Arian Bakhtiarnia, Qi Zhang, Alexandros Iosifidis
read_findings: Sorting and pacing differ; frozen-backbone early exits use teacher cross-entropy ranking; compare vanilla, random, curriculum and anti-curriculum with matched initialization. CIFAR evidence is not HSI observation-curriculum evidence.
officiality: Explicitly linked by original paper footnote1
access: 2026-11-09 repository redirects to serviceinfo.au.dk/da/home/message/7381; project API inaccessible through available web reader. Source and license remain unverified.
reuse: No upstream code copied or executed. CUR-O independently permutes fixed observation records; CUR-S independently scores only released devtrain support with frozen teacher fused NLL, then uses positive per-class normalized weights. No growing pool or validation/test-based ranking.
difference: CUR-O fixed marginal exposure and CUR-S soft within-class weights are separate mechanisms. CUR-S retains all support and current-block class mass, freezes teacher cost/identity, and leaves class-first sampler/full-validation selection unchanged. Teacher memorization/domain bias and finite-budget participation remain limitations; not upstream reproduction.
